title: NEOptimized
body:
## The ultimate client side Quality Of Life (QOL) modpack
**This modpack is created so you can enjoy minecraft as much as possible while still being playable on any world/server.**

**Please remember to activate resource packs for best experience.**

## QOL;
- **[Dynamic Lights](https://modrinth.com/mod/lambdynamiclights)**
- **Enhanced ui with lots of new animations.**
- **Better sounds phyiscs + Ambient sounds based on biome.**
- **Lots of new [Animations](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations)+[Moves](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/tras-fresh-player) on Characters (Players) and Mobs.**
- **Better textures such as Connected Blocks, Clouds, Crops, Armors Trims and 3d Ladders/Rails.**
- **Better overlays like better advancements, f3 and chat. And seamless loading screens**
 
## Performance;
**Of course a QOL modpack wouldn't be good without performance so optimizations via Sodium, Distant Horizons, Culling, Modern Fix, etc. makes a potato pc:
 ![minimum requirements](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6f8f68eb2598fd6b3a0344b5e9e3c42258ec5065.webp) 
able to run this modpack.**
